audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreement: full phases[0,4,5,6].side all read 'Skill' while content win[0]/[6] read 'Lulu' and win[4]/[5] read 'Thresh'.
audit.why: Lulu's Glitterlance/Pix poke wins level 1 before Thresh has Flay; Thresh spikes at 6 and first item since his all-in outpaces her single defensive R and can burst through one shield; late items flip it back to Lulu once Polymorph and Wild Growth fully answer the engage — exactly what content.whys[0,4,5,6] already state.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0].side and phases[6].side to 'Lulu', phases[4,5].side to 'Thresh' (matching win[]), and rewrote each .why to state the reason.

audit.why: Lulu-favored level 1, even 2-5 once Flay answers her step-ups, Thresh-favored 6/first-item, Lulu-favored again with 2+ items once her peel stacks.
Level 2 Flay answers her step-ups, level 6/first-item is Thresh's all-in window before her R and shields stack, late Polymorph/Wild Growth flip peel to Lulu.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Whimsy as matchup-defining but carried no cooldown number; report[8].t misgenders Lulu as 'his'.
audit.why: Whimsy (W) is a flat 18s cooldown at all ranks. Lulu is she/her per champ-gender.js.
audit.corrected: Added the 18s cooldown; fixed the pronoun.
